author: Sai
name: Kingshot
short: MightPulse Kingshot statistics, alliance history and KvK dashboards
description: Kingshot statistics, alliance snapshots, preparation dashboards, reminders and unverified self-service governor linking with server nickname/role sync. Mighty is required for events and KvK.
install_msg: Load kingshot, then use [p]ksset apikey to configure Red's shared MightPulse token securely. See [p]help ks and the kingshot README.
end_user_data_statement: Stores guild settings, dashboard IDs, public game snapshots, manual events and reminder markers. Linking stores per-server Discord member/governor associations, timestamps, cog-assigned role IDs and original/applied/pending nicknames for cleanup. Links are unverified. Red data deletion removes member linking records. API keys use Red's shared token storage.
